description: Read Google Trends for search terms: a summary per term (average, latest, and peak interest, recent change, top region, top and rising queries) plus flat rows for interest over time, by region, metro, or city, and related queries. Values are relative 0 to 100, not search counts. Compare up to 5 terms on one scale. No Google account or key.

category.description: Google Trends category number. 0 is all categories. The number is in the cat= part of a Trends URL.

compare.description: true: terms are charted together in groups of 5, on one shared scale. false: each term gets its own chart. Each term is charged either way.

geo.description: Empty for worldwide, or a Google geo code such as US, DE, or US-CA.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

outputs.description: Any of interest_over_time, interest_by_region, related_queries, related_topics. Default is the first three. See Limitations for related_topics.

property.description: Which Google search to read: web, news, images, youtube, or shopping.

proxy_mode.description: auto (default): requests go through the Apify proxy pool, and a request the pool cannot get through is retried on residential addresses. residential: every request uses residential addresses. A reliability setting only; it does not change what you pay.

region_resolution.description: auto: countries worldwide, regions inside a country. DMA is US metro areas. CITY needs a geo. COUNTRY needs an empty geo.

terms.description: Search terms, up to 200 per run. A Google topic ID such as /m/0j6n6s8 also works.

timeframe.description: now 1-H, now 4-H, now 1-d, now 7-d, today 1-m, today 3-m, today 12-m, today 5-y, all, or two dates as YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_google_trends
title: Get Google Trends data
